notes.title: Release Follow-up
notes.notes:
This time I have some quality of life improvements and fixes – small but important changes.

The changes include:

Music can now be muted via BigScreen™

Controls shown in the manual can be rebinded to support broken keys, favorite layouts and enhanced accessibility

Bug fixes for Station and drone Editor

Small performance tweaks, the game should now run better on lower end hardware

Bug fixes for Resource extractor, correctly handling 4+ resource types and not stopping after every type.



Next up:

focus on performance improvements

improvements and tweaks for Modules and their required resources

Video and performance settings

improvements for drone movement

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
After some all-nighters the first public version of debris is now available! 🎉

There are still many things that need to be improved and many more ideas for more content – but for now I am looking forward to your feedback.

Limitations of the Demo version are:

Progress cannot be saved

Total playtime is around 30 minutes to an hour

limited number of modules

limited story



Thanks to all the people that already tried it, your feedback was very valuable and I am looking forward to getting your feedback in the future as well!



Changes compared to last time include:

dust around areas of debris are now colored based on their resources (setup for future update)

thruster startup and shutdown animation

Improved onboarding and general explanation of the game

various UI fixes, for example disabled buttons, animations and sounds

various bugs with

station editor

drone editor

story 

BigScreen™

Manual

have been found and fixed





Planned things to come:

Automated bases, that can be deployed at various locations, that require your resource managing skills

Better visuals
Especially during the night, the objects should look more in line with the scene

Better Camera movement

Racing-inspired "tuning-section": your drone will always be there and you can tinker on it before taking a flight
